claim: On a team of two, critiqued motion principles across an Apple MacBook Air clip and a 3D comic animation in a video presentation.
detail: Evaluated squash and stretch, ease-in and ease-out timing variation, anticipation, follow-through, and scene cohesion against the 12 principles of animation.

claim: Created monochromatic, analogous, complementary, and triadic color-chip palettes and matched two schemes to reference artwork.
On a team of two, critiqued a medication-error Pareto chart and an employee radar chart in a video presentation.
detail: Evaluated nominal and ratio encodings, dual axes, an 80% threshold rule, red-green colorblindness risks, overplotting, and radial area distortion, recommending grouped bar or parallel-coordinates charts.

claim: Mapped the horizon line and vanishing points on a building photograph to analyze classic two-point linear perspective.
detail: Estimated viewer eye level at 4 to 5 feet above ground based on the constructed horizon line.

claim: Built a webpage demonstrating three typographic hierarchy combinations using modular type scales from a 16px base size.
detail: Implemented one- and two-typeface pairings across 1.200 Minor Third, 1.333 Perfect Fourth, and 1.141 Augmented Fourth scales.

claim: Analyzed unity, emphasis, balance, and rhythm across architectural and nature photography compositions.
detail: Examined visual hierarchy, radial and asymmetrical equilibrium, color contrast, and progressive repetition, alongside the 1.6 golden ratio.
